auth.newAccountNote: New here? Signing in with Google also creates your account. To keep bots out, we open every account by hand, so the first time we’ll ask you to say hello.

pending.title: Almost there!
pending.why: Agricolala is a one-person project. To keep bots out, every new account is opened by hand. Just send us a short message to introduce yourself: we’ll be more than happy to give you access.
pending.requestText: Open a short request on GitHub and tell us who you are and a little about your vineyard. You’ll need a free GitHub account. Requests are public, so don’t write your email or other personal details: your account code is already in the request, and it’s all we need to find your account.
pending.nextText: We usually open accounts within a few days. Once yours is open, just come back and sign in again.

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By accessing and using Agricolala ("the Service"), you accept and agree to be bound by the terms and provision of this agreement. If you do not agree to abide by the above, please do not use this service.

description.title: 2. Description of Service
description.content: Agricolala is an agricultural management application that allows users to:
listItems: Track agricultural parcels and their characteristics
Record treatment applications and chemical usage
Monitor substance usage and compliance
Generate reports and analytics for agricultural operations

responsibilities.title: 3. User Responsibilities
responsibilities.content: As a user of this Service, you agree to:
listItems: Provide accurate and complete information about your agricultural operations
Comply with all applicable local, state, and federal agricultural regulations
Use the Service only for lawful agricultural purposes
Maintain the security of your account credentials
Not share your account with unauthorized users
Report any suspected security breaches immediately

compliance.title: 4. Agricultural Data and Compliance
compliance.content: Important Disclaimer: This application is designed to assist with agricultural record-keeping and is not a substitute for professional agricultural advice or regulatory compliance.
listItems: Users are responsible for ensuring compliance with all applicable agricultural regulations
The Service does not guarantee regulatory compliance or agricultural outcomes
Users must verify all chemical usage data against official product labels and regulations
Agricultural decisions should be made in consultation with qualified professionals

dataOwnership.title: 5. Data Ownership and Usage
content: Your Data: You retain ownership of all agricultural data you enter into the Service.
Service Usage: We may use aggregated, anonymized data to improve the Service, provide analytics, and train machine learning models in an anonymized way.
Data Export: You can export your data at any time through the Service's export features.

liability.title: 6. Limitation of Liability
liability.content: Agricultural Disclaimer: The Service is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. We are not liable for:
listItems: Crop losses or agricultural outcomes based on data entered in the Service
Regulatory compliance issues or violations
Incorrect chemical application rates or timing
Service interruptions or data loss
Decisions made based on the information provided by the Service

information.title: 1. Information We Collect
content: Account Information: When you create an account, we collect your name, email address, and authentication information.
Agricultural Data: We collect data you enter about your agricultural operations, including:
listItems: Parcel information (location, size, crop type)
Treatment applications and timing
Chemical usage and substance tracking
Product applications and dosages
Disease and pest management records
information.additionalContent: Usage Data: We collect information about how you use the Service, including access times, features used, and performance data.

usage.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
listItems: Provide and maintain the Service
Generate agricultural reports and analytics
Calculate substance usage aggregations
Send you important updates about the Service
Improve and develop new features
Train machine learning models using anonymized data to enhance agricultural insights and predictions
Ensure compliance with agricultural regulations
Provide customer support

sharing.title: 3. Data Sharing and Disclosure
content: We do not sell your agricultural data to third parties.
We may share your information in the following limited circumstances:
listItems: Service Providers: With trusted third-party services that help us operate the Service (hosting, analytics, etc.)
Legal Requirements: When required by law or to protect our rights and safety
Regulatory Compliance: When necessary to comply with agricultural regulations
Aggregated Data: We may share anonymized, aggregated data for research, analytics, or machine learning model training purposes

security.title: 4. Data Security
security.content: We implement appropriate security measures to protect your agricultural data:
listItems: Encryption of data in transit and at rest
Secure authentication and access controls
Regular security audits and updates
Limited access to your data by authorized personnel only
Backup and disaster recovery procedures

retention.title: 5. Data Retention
content: Agricultural Records: We retain your agricultural data for as long as your account is active, as these records are often required for regulatory compliance and may need to be maintained for several years.
Account Data: We retain your account information for as long as your account is active, plus a reasonable period for backup and recovery purposes.
Deletion: You may request deletion of your data, but please note that agricultural records may need to be maintained for regulatory compliance purposes.

rights.title: 6. Your Rights
rights.content: You have the following rights regarding your data:
listItems: Access: View and download your agricultural data
Correction: Update or correct inaccurate information
Export: Export your data in a portable format
Deletion: Request deletion of your data (subject to regulatory requirements)
Restriction: Limit how we process your data
Portability: Transfer your data to another service

cookies.title: 7. Cookies and Tracking
cookies.content: We use essential cookies to provide the Service functionality. We do not use tracking cookies or third-party analytics that could compromise your privacy.

children.title: 8. Children's Privacy
children.content: Our Service is not intended for children under 13 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you are a parent or guardian and believe your child has provided us with personal information, please contact us.

international.title: 9. International Data Transfers
international.content: Your data may be processed in countries other than your own. We ensure appropriate safeguards are in place to protect your data in accordance with applicable data protection laws.

changes.title: 10. Changes to This Policy
changes.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of significant changes via email or through the Service. Your continued use of the Service after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

contact.title: 11. Contact Us
contact.content: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or want to exercise your data rights, please contact us through the application or at the email address provided in your account settings.

meta.title: Agricolala: your vineyard’s treatment notebook
meta.description: Free, open-source app for winegrowers. Map your parcels, log every treatment at the growth stage it happened, and use as few treatments as you can.

hero.lead: Map parcels. Log treatments. Use as few as you can.
hero.note: Free and open source, made by one person. To keep bots out, new accounts are opened by hand: sign in, say hello, and we’ll let you in.

season.title: From the first bud to the last bunch.
season.description: The vine sets the calendar, not the other way round. Follow your parcels through the eight stages of the season and see every treatment where it happened.
season.caption: Example season: the treatments made at each stage.

app.title: Your whole vineyard, in your pocket.
app.description: Made for the phone you carry between the rows. Open it to see which diseases to watch at today’s growth stage, and how much of each substance you have used this year.
app.imageAlt: The Agricolala home screen on a phone: disease risk at flowering and substance usage this year

features.title: Disease risk
features.description: Powdery and downy mildew risk through the season, marked at the stage your vines are in. Still experimental.

features.title: Substance usage
features.description: Copper, sulfur and every other active substance, month by month.

features.title: One tap away
features.description: Parcels, treatments and your profile sit in the bottom bar.

usage.title: 4 kg of copper per hectare, each year. Always in view.
usage.description: Every treatment is added up from 1 January and counted against the yearly limit, parcel by parcel and across the whole vineyard. Rain washes copper off the leaves, never off the counter.
usage.meterLabel: Copper used this year, against the yearly limit

openSource.title: Free for every grower. Open for everyone to read.
openSource.description: Agricolala costs nothing, and its code is public. We believe the tools that help growers farm cleaner should belong to the people who use them: you can check how every number is calculated, suggest improvements, or run it yourself.
